LanguageData.SSC_RES_BasicTraining.label: Training
LanguageData.SSC_RES_BasicTraining.description: Study surviving training manuals to learn practical training methods.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_BodyPartTraining.label: Body-part Training
LanguageData.SSC_RES_BodyPartTraining.description: Study targeted training methods for specific body parts, granting bonuses through training.\n\nCompleting genital training (100%) grants Nano-Aphrodisiac Secretion. The body consumes nutrition to accumulate progress automatically and produces ordinary PNA when progress is full. Completing this research alone does not grant secretion; the corresponding body part must still be fully trained.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNASimpleApp.label: Basic PNA Applications
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNASimpleApp.description: Learn the first surgical applications of aphrodisiac nanofluid, using injections during operations for modification and training.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_SexChange.label: Sex Reassignment Surgery (Male to Female)
LanguageData.SSC_RES_SexChange.description: Turns men into women (not implemented, and planned to include cosmetic surgery).
LanguageData.SSC_RES_Femboy.label: Femboy Conversion
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNAConcentration.label: PNA Concentration Technology
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PE.label: Personality Excretion
LanguageData.SSC_RES_SlaveSpecialization.label: Personality Editing
LanguageData.SSC_RES_SlaveSpecialization.description: Unlocks sex slave specialization training. Research a path to select it in the personality tab once implemented. Progress is saved separately for each path when switching. See each path's research description for its effects and experience sources.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_CowTraining.label: Milking Specialization
LanguageData.SSC_RES_CowTraining.description: Effects: A sex slave at chain stage 2 with lactation can select Cow. It gains extra milk storage, and sex accelerates milk production more as training progresses. At 20%, vulnerability rises while movement and manipulation fall; at 50%, beauty rises. A completed path can be finalized with personality gel.\n\nExperience: Gained from the amount of milk production advanced, including sex driven production and Human Cattle lactation consumption. Sex alone grants no Cow experience without milk production progress.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PublicUse.label: Public Use
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PublicUse.description: Effects: Unlocks the Bus path, which allows and enforces receiving consensual and forced sex. At 20% and 50%, trade prices, negotiation, social impact, and talking improve. Trades with a pawn trader may trigger an interaction. A completed path can be finalized with personality gel.\n\nExperience: Completing sex with someone other than the master grants 5%; daily training adds progress based on its outcome; successful faction or pawn trader deals also add progress. Ship trades do not count.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_TrainerOfficer.label: Training Officer Specialization
LanguageData.SSC_RES_TrainerOfficer.description: Effects: A free colonist with sex slave identity, a bound master, and chain stage 3 can select Training Officer. Selection permits initiating consensual or forced sex. At 20%, its personal trainer switch can be enabled to train other sex slaves and it gains mental break threshold, suppression, and conversion bonuses; these improve at 50%. A completed path can be finalized with personality gel.\n\nExperience: Completing training as the receiver or a binding ritual grants 5%; completing training as a qualified, enabled trainer grants 2.5%; initiating and completing sex with another pawn grants 1%.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PetCat.label: Pet: Cat
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PetCat.description: SSC sex slaves can choose Pet Cat after completing Training and this research. Training improves movement speed and hunting stealth. Finalization unlocks Gentle Comfort.\n\nDaily training and completed binding rituals grant progress. Idle cats can show affection to their bound master for a brief mood boost. Successful affection grants 1 percentage point during ordinary training, at most once per day. Successful affection has a 20% chance of a follow-up if both are consenting adults aged 18 or older and permissions allow it.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_Combatant.label: Combatant
LanguageData.SSC_RES_Combatant.description:
Guides purple nanomachine fluid to further reshape a sex slave's body and nervous system, improving weapon control, physical protection and stress responses. Set the pawn's SSC identity to Sex Slave; no bound master or chain stage is required. Basic bonuses begin at 20% progress, with stronger bonuses and ongoing damage reduction at 50%.

Progress comes from completed daily Training and direct kills. Each Training session grants up to 4 percentage points, or up to 6 when conducted by the bound master. Kill rewards scale with the target's actual body size, up to 3 percentage points per kill. Binding Rituals, slaughter and indirect deaths grant no experience.

Once training is complete, process the personality gel into a final combatant at a sculpting table. Implanting it grants permanent combat bonuses and Combat Overdrive, which actively stimulates the body's purple nanomachines. Switching specializations preserves each direction's progress; final bonuses stay with the personality.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PetDog.label: Pet: Dog
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PetDog.description: SSC sex slaves can choose Pet Dog after completing Training and this research. Training improves taming chance, animal training chance, and plant work speed. Finalization unlocks Animal Training.\n\nDaily training and completed binding rituals grant progress. Training attempts, taming attempts, and completed sex with an animal grant a base 0.4, 0.6, and 2 percentage points respectively. These gains scale with progress. Idle dogs can show affection to their bound master for a brief mood boost. Successful affection has a 20% chance of a follow-up if both are consenting adults aged 18 or older and permissions allow it. Animal work may trigger a follow-up event.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PetRabbit.label: Pet: Rabbit
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PetRabbit.description: SSC sex slaves can choose Pet Rabbit after completing Training and this research. Training improves cleaning and cooking speed. Finalization unlocks Careful Cooking.\n\nDaily training and completed binding rituals grant progress. Each pile of filth cleared grants 0.20 percentage points. Each qualifying meal cooked grants 0.10 percentage points.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_GelatinizationPartial.label: Partial Gelatinization
LanguageData.SSC_RES_GelatinizationFull.label: Full-body Gelatinization
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNAConcentration.description: Learn to process ordinary aphrodisiac nanofluid into concentrate. Efficient processing at a drug lab turns 5 units of raw fluid into 1 unit of concentrate, or 20 into 4. The less efficient method at a campfire, fueled stove or electric stove requires 10 units of raw fluid for 1 unit of concentrate.\n\nBoth methods yield the same product and require raw fluid. This research unlocks concentration only; it does not grant bodily secretion. Ordinary raw fluid can be produced automatically by a body with fully trained genitals.
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PetFox.label: Pet: Fox
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PetFox.description: SSC sex slaves can choose Pet Fox after completing Training and this research. Training improves research speed, tend speed, and tend quality. Finalization unlocks Emergency Bandaging.\n\nDaily training and completed binding rituals grant progress. Every 100 points of research added at a bench grant 0.25 percentage points. Each completed tend on another humanlike patient grants 0.10 percentage points.
